cronMonitoring.latestStatusBefore: “Access expiration check” and “category-follower notification email” don't have their own separate Cron — they run on the cadence that
cronMonitoring.latestStatusAfter: is actually invoked. The expected frequency for these two should therefore always be set equal to or greater than the main worker's Cron frequency.

backups.fullGuideDescBefore: Covers how to back up the database (Supabase Automatic Backups and manual
backups.fullGuideDescMiddle: ), how to back up files across all 4 Storage buckets, recommended frequency, recovery steps, and how to test a recovery plan — see full details in the file
backups.noBackupButtonTitle: Why there's no "Back Up Now" button
backups.noBackupButtonDesc: Supabase has no public API for external applications to trigger a backup or read Backup status directly (automatic backups are a platform-level feature Supabase manages, checkable and configurable only via the Supabase Dashboard). This page intentionally has no non-functional backup button to click — so Super Admins aren't misled into thinking a backup is happening when it isn't.

roles.heading: Roles & Permissions
roles.subtitle: Overview of all 5 role tiers in the system and each role's core permissions.
roles.infoBox: This system uses numeric rank-based permissions — a role with a higher rank automatically gets everything a lower-rank role has. This page is read-only, since the system doesn't yet support fine-grained per-item permissions — editing rank values directly carries a high risk of breaking the entire permission hierarchy, so it isn't editable from this page.

staff: View status and edit own submissions (/my-submissions)
librarian: View research in every status for review
super_admin: Access the entire Super Admin Dashboard (/superadmin) — regular Admins cannot
Grant/revoke the Super Admin role for other users (at least 1 must always remain)
Edit the role hierarchy (roles table) directly
Edit advanced system settings (registration/submission, file size, security, notifications)

stats.description: Track view and download counts for each research item.

about.rolesSubtitle: The system supports 5 user tiers, each with different access permissions.

roleDescriptions.guest: Browse public research and view basic information without signing in.
roleDescriptions.member: Read and download member-level research, and save favorites.
roleDescriptions.staff: Access staff-level research and submit research to the system.
roleDescriptions.librarian: Review, approve, or request revisions for submitted research.
roleDescriptions.admin: Administer the system, manage users, categories, and view all reports.

myAccessRequestsPage.pageDescription: Track the status of access/download requests you've submitted.
myAccessRequestsPage.heading: My Access Requests
myAccessRequestsPage.subtitle: Track the status of read/download requests you've sent to staff.
myAccessRequestsPage.emptyDesc: You can submit a request from the detail page of research you don't have permission to read/download.
